hero.desc: We deliver AI-powered citizen services that strengthen public safety, empower every district, and build lasting trust between the Karnataka State Police and the people it serves.

what_we_do.desc: From first report to final resolution, we provide end-to-end digital services tailored to every citizen's needs.

services_list.s1_desc: Report an incident in plain Kannada, English, or Hindi through a simple guided chat.
services_list.s2_desc: AI reviews the complaint and recommends the correct applicable legal sections.
services_list.s3_desc: Every case is tracked with tamper-evident records from filing through disposal.
services_list.s4_desc: District-level dashboards help the SCRB spot patterns and allocate resources.

about.desc: At KAVACH, we combine AI, legal expertise, and community trust to help citizens across Karnataka report incidents and access justice quickly and transparently.
about.badge_desc: Delivering safety and building lasting community partnerships.

login.side_text: Secure sign-in for citizens filing reports and officers managing cases across every district.
login.citizen_subtitle: Report an incident or track your complaint status.
login.officer_subtitle: Access your case dashboard and manage FIR filings.
login.error_not_role: This account is not a {{tab}} account.
login.footer: All sessions are encrypted and audit-logged per SCRB protocol.
